meta.purpose: Eric’s EXAMPLE collection seed — editable, not a live inventory API.
meta.ownership: A form is owned when forms[formId] is true (≥1 full-art / illustration of that form). The All forms pill is a rollup: filled if any form flag is true. Species.owned is the same rollup, kept in sync for Delibird.
meta.note: Delibird updates this JSON via pull request when prints are acquired. Form keys must match catalog ids from species-forms-catalog-v1.json (formIdFromLabel).
meta.seed: Meowth matches the D1 rev3 mock (Base / Alolan empty; Galarian owned; Gigantamax catalog-only). Charizard is a second EXAMPLE species (Base owned).
